ProfitCalculation
Stores the outcome of a single "Calculate Profit" request: the income and total cost that were used, and the resulting profit or loss (profit = income - cost) for a Shipment.
ProfitCalculationController
REST API for the "Calculate Profit" use case.
ProfitCalculationMapper
Maps ProfitCalculation entities to their API representation, ProfitLossDto, so the persistence model is never exposed directly to controller consumers.
ProfitCalculationRepository
Data access layer for ProfitCalculation entities.
ProfitLossCalculationService
Business logic for the "Calculate Profit" use case: records the income and cost submitted for a shipment, computes profit = income - cost, persists the result, and lets it be looked up afterwards.
ProfitLossDto
Response payload returned after calculating (or listing) the profit/loss of a shipment: profitLossValue = totalIncome - totalCost.
Shipment
Represents a single shipment (main carriage) handled by the logistics company.
ShipmentApplication
Entry point of the Shipment Profit/Loss calculation service.
ShipmentDto
Request payload for the "Calculate Profit" use case (see ProfitCalculationController).
ShipmentNotFoundException
Thrown when no Shipment matches the requested reference.
ShipmentReferenceNotFoundException
Thrown when it's not possible to get the shipment references list.
ShipmentRepository
Data access layer for Shipment entities.
ShipmentService
Handles persistence of the income and cost data entered for a shipment (customer payment administration and operational cost administration, as described in the use case document).
